instruction.name: xvfcvth.d.s
instruction.description: Convert single precision floating point elements in higher half of every 128-bit vector of `a` to double precision.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfcvth.d.s $xr0, $xr8; xvfcvth.d.s $xr1, $xr9; xvfcvth.d.s $xr2, $xr10; xvfcvth.d.s $xr3, $xr11; xvfcvth.d.s $xr4, $xr12; xvfcvth.d.s $xr5, $xr13; xvfcvth.d.s $xr6, $xr14; xvfcvth.d.s $xr7, $xr15
